messages:
Nina (Marketing): Quick thread for tomorrow's "Open Stack" meetup activation. Need confirmations: booth signage, speaker AV check, swag tally, merch distribution policy, and inbound lead tagging. Short and practical please.
Ethan - Events: Load-in confirmed 3:30p. I'll be at dock by 3:15.
Jonas Ops: Where's the golden equipment case? Warehouse says it's in rack B7. Who's driving?
Ethan - Events: I'll swing by the warehouse at 2:30 and pick it up.
Carmen (Design): New backdrop print is fragile  pack in poster tube and don't lay flat with tees. Also the grommet kit is in the small accessory pouch.
Priya (Content): For the bench narrative: we want to emphasize "consistent latency across hosted and private deployments" in the handouts and the demo script. Keep it short on the one-pager, longer on the tech deep-dive.
Nina (Marketing): Agree. Use 2-line tagline on stickers: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency"
Carmen (Design): Confirmed. Stickers and one-pager updated. QR points to /open-stack-demo?utm=meetup.
BadgeBot: Reminder: Speaker badges printed and in envelope labeled "OpenStack_Speaker_Badges".
Jonas Ops: AV checklist: HDMI, USB-C adapter, spare batteries, lav mic, HDMI splitter for live stream. Also bring a travel router for local network fallback.
Ethan - Events: I'll pack the splitter. Who's handling live stream?
Priya (Content): I'll run the stream via my laptop and StreamKey. Ethan  can you confirm the venue allows outbound streaming on their wifi?
Ethan - Events: Venue allows streaming but recommends wired ethernet from the dock. I'll run a line.
Nina (Marketing): Lead routing: Two channels. 1) QR for demo signups (captures email + role) tagged 'event:openstack-demodemo'. 2) Business card drop for raffle (name + company only) tagged 'event:openstack-raffle'. Carmen  ensure the QR appears on the demo slide and the one-pager.
Carmen (Design): Done. Demo slide has QR top-right; one-pager bottom-left.
Priya (Content): I'll draft the instant follow-up email: subject "Thanks for stopping by Redwood @ Open Stack". Call-to-action: book a tech review (cal link) + download benchmark summary.
Nina (Marketing): Benchmark narrative calls out: 50% cost reduction vs baseline when using caching/batching, 30% lower p50 latency on dedicated configs. Keep it non-numeric in the one-pager: "substantially lower cost and consistent p50 latency". We'll reserve the numbers for the benchmark PDF.
Jonas Ops: Swag inventory per box: 100 tees (S-XL), 250 stickers, 100 one-pagers, 30 mugs. If we expect 200 attendees, we should ration tees for contest winners only.
Ethan - Events: Agree. We'll give stickers and one-pagers freely. Contest winners get tees + mugs.
Nina (Marketing): Raffle rules: 2 winners, pick at end of event at 8:50pm. Need a live tally board (whiteboard) and someone to film the live draw for socials.
Priya (Content): I'll film. Also quick ask  where are the social assets for the live story? Carmen?
Carmen (Design): IG story templates and 4:5 vertical hero ready in the kit.
BadgeBot: Reminder: Vendor insurance docs uploaded to portal.
Nina (Marketing): Final logistics:
```
- Meet at dock 3:25pm for quick load-in huddle
- Booth ready by 4:45pm
- Demo slot 6:30pm (Priya presenting)
- Stream test at 5:30pm
- Raffle draw 8:50pm
- Teardown starts 9:10pm
```
Jonas Ops: One last: bring spare power strip and extension. I left one in the case but better to double up.
Ethan - Events: Copy.
Nina (Marketing): If anything changes, update here. See you all tomorrow! :party_popper:
